projects.title: Dust Walkers
projects.description: Dust Walkers is a top-down action roguelite base defense game. Players deploy as Dust Walkers, elite operatives tasked with protecting a mining operation against relentless waves of enemies across a hostile galaxy. The game blends base building, squad tactics, and roguelite progression into a single-player experience built around escalating runs and game-breaking builds.

projects.title: West Coast Summit Supply
projects.description: West Coast Summit Supply is a fictional outdoor gear store brought to life through a custom-built e-commerce website. Designed with WordPress and WooCommerce, this project served as the capstone for the BCIT FWD program.
key_features: Custom WP Hooks & Templates - Enhanced functionality with templates and custom WordPress hooks
Custom JavaScript - Improved interactivity and dynamic elements for a smooth user experience
Google Maps Store Finder - Integrated a store locator using the Google Maps API

projects.title: Portfolio Site
projects.description: This portfolio site was built using React and Tailwind CSS. It serves as a showcase of my projects and skills, while also being a project in itself.
